data.summary: This directory contains CSV-based relational data schemas and sample records representing an e-commerce data model including customers, orders, order items, and products.

file_insights.name: customers.csv
file_insights.summary: Defines the customer data schema and records.
file_insights.source_summary: Contains CSV headers: customer_id, name, city, membership_tier, updated_at.
file_insights.detailed_description: This CSV file defines the schema and data structure for customer records, including customer ID, name, city, membership tier, and update timestamp.

file_insights.name: order_items.csv
file_insights.summary: Defines the order items transactional schema and records.
file_insights.source_summary: Contains CSV headers: order_item_id, order_id, product_id, quantity, unit_price, updated_at.
file_insights.detailed_description: This CSV file represents the line items associated with customer orders, capturing product quantities and pricing at the item level.

file_insights.name: orders.csv
file_insights.summary: Defines the orders schema and stores order transaction headers.
file_insights.source_summary: Contains CSV headers and a sample record for order header data (order_id, customer_id, order_status, ordered_at, updated_at).
file_insights.detailed_description: This CSV file contains customer order header information, such as order status, creation timestamp, and customer reference.
responsibilities: Store order header data and status

file_insights.name: products.csv
file_insights.summary: Defines the product catalog schema and records.
file_insights.source_summary: Contains CSV headers: product_id, name, category, price, updated_at.
file_insights.detailed_description: This CSV file defines the product catalog schema, including product category, pricing, and update metadata.
